featured_reviews.name: SAHIL RATNAPARKHI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited FunTime Carnival and overall it was a really great experience. It’s an all-year-round carnival with a good variety of rides, each priced differently — ₹100, ₹200, or ₹300 per person.
The entry ticket is ₹100 per head, and that ticket can be used for any ride of the same cost, which is a nice and flexible system.
We had a great time — bumper cars, kids’ play area, and the zip-line adventure zone were definite highlights. We visited in the second week after opening, so some rides were still being installed and work was ongoing, which is understandable.

One major downside was the Arcade zone inside. It consists of machine games and prize-winning games. Entry is ₹200 per person, and you get three attempts at each of the five games. However, you only get a prize if you win all five games, which is practically impossible since a few games are quite tricky.
The prize is just a small (~30 cm) stuffed toy, which is not worth the price. Bigger toys are displayed but cannot be won. This wasn’t clearly explained beforehand — otherwise, we wouldn’t have played at all. I’d strongly suggest skipping the Arcade section.
Another drawback was the food, which felt way too expensive for what was offered.

Despite these two points, we had a great time overall and would definitely visit again, mainly for the rides and overall carnival vibe.

It’s rare to find a place where the staff is so naturally warm and engaging with kids while also being respectful and polite with parents. Their genuine effort to ensure children are safe, happy, and actively involved makes all the difference and allows us to relax while the kids enjoy themselves.The play area itself is thoughtfully designed with a wide variety of activities. The ball pool and slides are safe and well-maintained, puzzles are engaging, and the toy kitchen setup is a big hit—with plenty of utensils, fruits, and vegetables that make playtime feel realistic and fun. There’s also great scope for imaginative play with doctor and mechanic kits, which really encourages creativity and role-play. One of the biggest attractions is the sand pit, filled with child-safe seeds, which the kids absolutely love.

Cleanliness is another area where this place really shines. The play area as well as the café are maintained to an excellent standard of hygiene, which adds a lot of comfort and trust for families.

The café is a wonderful addition for parents. The food is fresh, hygienic, and served quickly—perfect for a quick break while the kids play. The spicy Maggi prepared by Ms. Lakshmi is definitely worth trying—it stands out!

We’d also like to appreciate some of the amazing staff members like Ms. Gauri, Ms. Minakshi, Ms. Shraddha, and Ms. Rutuja. They are efficient, kind, and truly wonderful with children. Honestly, every team member here comes across as humble, approachable, and great with kids.

All in all, Kidz Fun Zoo offers the perfect mix of a safe, fun-filled environment for children and a relaxing space for parents. Highly recommended for a stress-free and enjoyable family outing!
